title: Build a completely new website (different design and concept)

requirements.text: Replace the existing CRACKIUM SSC coaching website with a completely new website. The new site must have a distinct concept, design language, color palette, and layout — nothing should visually resemble or reuse the current orange/glassmorphism dark-themed SSC academy site.
acceptanceCriteria: The new site has a completely different visual identity (colors, typography, layout) from the previous CRACKIUM site
No orange glow borders, glassmorphism cards, or SSC coaching content from the previous design are present
The site has a coherent, polished look and feel with a clear new theme

requirements.text: Apply a bold, creative visual theme to the new website — choose a distinct style (e.g., clean minimal, editorial, vibrant gradient, brutalist, nature-inspired, etc.) with a unique color palette, typography pairing, and layout that is consistently applied across all sections.
acceptanceCriteria: A clearly defined color palette (not blue/purple, not orange) is used consistently across all components
Typography choices are intentional and distinct from the previous site
All sections follow the same design language

requirements.text: The backend Motoko actor should remain as a minimal empty actor. No backend functionality is required for this new website.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo compiles successfully as an empty or minimal actor
No new backend endpoints or data models are added

constraints: Do not reuse any visual design elements (colors, card styles, section layouts, content) from the previous CRACKIUM SSC coaching site
Do not use blue or purple as the primary color palette
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Keeping any part of the CRACKIUM SSC coaching site design or content
Adding authentication or Internet Identity login flows
Adding backend data persistence or canister logic
